extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A novel dataset featuring human-crafted instructions that require context-sensitive reasoning for text-rich images
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset comprises images sourced from six different sources: LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Secondary Data analysis, Document analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images for the Time, Shopping, Navigation & Abstract categories from the LAION-5B. Images for the Application Usage category from the Rico Dataset. Images for the Web Usage category from the Open WebText Initiative. Images for the Infographic and Miscellaneous Natural Scenes categories from existing VQA datasets.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images that are categorized under Time, Shopping, Navigation, and Abstract undergo manual filtering. For Application Usage, Web Usage, Infographic, and Miscellaneous Natural Scenes, heuristic-based filtering is performed using PaddleOCR to detect text in the image.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Two groups of authors annotated four specific categories each. A verification process was performed by MTurk workers, and 96% of samples were annotated correctly.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: A subset of 100 samples will be released as a validation set, along with their reference responses. The remaining 406 samples will be kept hidden.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to evaluate the context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning capabilities of large multimodal models, which can have significant social implications for applications such as assisting the visually impaired.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset instances cannot be solved without precise visual perception, and the performance of models lags behind human performance.
